id.description: Pin the team id, e.g. to match installs your app already stored. Generated if left out.

token.description: Pin the user's token, to act as them with any Slack client.

members.description: User names or ids. The first member created the channel.

messages.description: Posted in order before any app is installed, so they send no events.

SlackChannelSpec.description: A channel, its members and its first messages.

installer.description: The user (name or id) who installs the app.
